name: Welcome Email
subject: Welcome to Enterprise Microservices Platform, {{name}}!
body:
Hello {{name}},

Thank you for joining our platform. Your account ({{email}}) is now active.

name: Order Confirmation
subject: Order Confirmed: #{{orderId}}
body:
Hi {{name}},

Your order #{{orderId}} of ${{totalAmount}} has been confirmed and is being processed.

name: Order Cancellation & Refund
subject: Order Cancelled: #{{orderId}}
body: Your order #{{orderId}} has been cancelled. A refund of ${{refundAmount}} was processed.
